items.title: Financial Services (JPMorgan Chase's Operations Capital)
items.description: Columbus hosts JPMorgan Chase's largest operational campus — tens of thousands of employees in card services, auto finance, retail banking operations, and technology. Nationwide Insurance (Columbus HQ) and Huntington Bancshares (Columbus HQ) round out a significant financial services concentration. Consumer credit and fraud detection: ML for JPMorgan's card and auto lending operations, Nationwide's insurance products, and Huntington's retail banking — with SR 26-2 validation and FCRA compliance. Financial document processing: AI automation for the enormous volume of financial documents that Columbus's banking and insurance operations process. Insurance underwriting and claims: ML for Nationwide's property, casualty, and life insurance underwriting and claims automation.
items.label: Financial Services

items.title: Retail and Fashion (Columbus's Most Distinctive Sector)
items.description: Columbus's retail headquarters concentration rivals Minneapolis's — L Brands (Victoria's Secret, Bath & Body Works), Abercrombie & Fitch, Big Lots, DSW, and Wendy's are all headquartered in Columbus or the immediate metro area. Demand forecasting: fashion and lifestyle retail demand prediction for Columbus's brand portfolio — incorporating trend cycles, social media signals, and seasonal patterns specific to fashion retail. Customer analytics: lifetime value prediction, churn modeling, and segmentation AI for Columbus's direct and wholesale fashion brands. Supply chain optimization: inventory positioning and procurement AI for Columbus's retail supply chains with global manufacturing exposure.
items.label: Retail & Fashion

items.title: Healthcare
items.description: OhioHealth (Columbus HQ), Nationwide Children's Hospital (top-10 US pediatric hospital), The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and Mount Carmel Health System. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI with Epic integration for Columbus's health systems.
